title: Ticket-detail journal entry
description: Contract for a journal-entry-import Mode B ticket-detail entry (YYYY/MM/YYYY-MM-DD-<key-lowercased>-<slug>.md): frontmatter properties plus structural expectations (x-* keywords) read by validate-ticket-detail.sh. Extends the base journal-entry-creator frontmatter contract with ticket-detail-specific rules.

title.description: Ticket key and summary, e.g. 'PROJ-2058 - Move to fetching credentials at run time'. Matches the H1 (minus the date suffix). Trackers whose keys are not PROJECT-NUMBER (e.g. a purely numeric issue number) need a locally adapted pattern.

date.description: Entry date (matches filename). Prefer the ticket's resolution/closed date; else its last-updated date; else the date of the log entry that mentioned it.

authors.description: Entry authors (typically the journal's usual author, e.g. Alex Rivera).

tags.description: Lowercase hyphenated tags. MUST include the key lowercased (e.g. proj-2058), topic tags, 'ticket-detail', and the four-digit year. Must match the ## Tags section. 'ticket-detail' extends the journal-entry-creator taxonomy's type facet alongside troubleshooting/learning/article/ticket-refinement.

source.description: The issue tracker's permalink to the ticket (e.g. a Jira browse URL, a Linear issue URL, a GitHub issue URL).

status.description: Publication status. Historical ticket-detail entries are normally 'published'.

$comment: refinement_ticket is forbidden: tekhne's base validator (validate-journal-entry.sh) requires a '## Proposed Ticket Description' section whenever refinement_ticket is set in frontmatter. That section is for an in-progress ticket-refinement draft (see journal-entry-creator's ticket-refinement type), not a reconstructed detail entry for a ticket that is already resolved. Cross-linking to the originating log entry uses plain markdown links; tekhne's base frontmatter schema has no continuation/supersession field, so do not invent one to express it.
